responsibility: Implements the IA-64 machine-description support for atomic and synchronization operations under GCC’s memory model. It defines fences, acquire/release loads and stores, compare-and-swap, exchange, fetchadd, and generic atomic fetch/update expanders, translating memmodel operands into IA-64 instructions such as mf, cmpxchg, xchg, and fetchadd and delegating more complex update sequences to ia64_expand_atomic_op in the backend.
